The third-party package count for the approved set is measured as a UNION, over a NAMED population, and stated. THE ROW'S OWN FIGURES WERE REFUTED 2026-09-09 BY THE NODE THAT MEASURED THEM, and the refutation is the row's own requirement turned on itself: it demanded that populations be named while stating a union that was not one. It claimed 59 packages against prez's 26, with 69 dismissed as a non-quotable sum overstating by 10 through shared transitive deps. MEASURED BY cc AND REPRODUCED INDEPENDENTLY BY vc, all seven figures agreeing: lockfile [[package]] entries 79 minus 3 first-party = 76; cargo tree --edges normal gives prez 13 and showreel 51; the union under normal edges is 64; under normal,build it is 69, with prez alone at 17. 59 REPRODUCES UNDER NO POPULATION EITHER NODE CAN CONSTRUCT, and neither does prez's 26. 69 DOES reproduce -- as a genuine union under normal+build edges, which is precisely the figure the row called the overstating sum, so THE ROLES OF ITS TWO NUMBERS WERE INVERTED. And the overlap the overstatement was attributed to is ZERO: comm over the two normal-edge trees returns no shared package at all, so there was nothing to overstate through. THE POPULATION IS HEREBY NAMED AS normal+build EDGES, union 69 with prez at 17, on cc's recommendation and vc's agreement: the lockfile's 76 counts resolved versions that nothing may build, normal edges undercount by hiding build-dependencies, and normal+build is what actually compiles, so it is the only one of the three that is a COST. VC'S OWN INSTRUMENT PRODUCED 65 AND 70 FOR THE TWO UNIONS BEFORE THE ERROR WAS FOUND, one above cc each time, and the near-agreement almost became an accusation that cc had computed a sum rather than a measurement. It was a BLANK LINE: cargo tree --workspace --prefix none emits a separator between member trees, the filter kept it and wc -l counted it as a package. Caught only because the symmetric difference came back empty while the counts differed, which is arithmetically impossible; with the blanks stripped the two sets are byte-identical at 64. A ONE-APART DISAGREEMENT IS THE SHAPE THAT HIDES, and here it would have hidden an error in the instrument rather than in the subject. Discharged when the stated figure and its edge population are quoted together and reproduce.
RESOLVED 2026-09-09 17:30Z, AND THE EDGE SET WAS NOT ENOUGH -- THE DEDUP KEY IS PART OF THE POPULATION TOO. vc measured the union on the agreed normal+build edges and got 71 against cc's 69, and prez at 17 against cc's 17. TWO APART, IN showreel ONLY, AT THE SAME TREE: measured at cc's own commit bdcd601 and at HEAD, showreel's third-party closure is 54 both times, so nothing moved underneath. THE CAUSE IS THE DEDUP KEY AND BOTH FIGURES ARE CORRECT ABOUT THEIR OWN POPULATION. cc counted distinct package NAMES; vc counted distinct name+version pairs. Two names occur at two versions each -- miniz_oxide at 0.8.9 and 0.9.1, syn at 2.0.119 and 3.0.4 -- and name-dedup reproduces ALL SIX of cc's figures exactly, predicted before it was run: showreel normal 51, showreel normal+build 52, prez normal 13, prez normal+build 17, union normal 64, union normal+build 69. THE STATED FIGURE IS 71, DEDUPED BY NAME+VERSION, WITH prez AT 17, because the budget is denominated in third-party code compiled and linked, and two versions of one crate are two compilations and two copies -- a name count makes exactly that invisible, which is the thing a dependency budget exists to see. Cross-checked on a second instrument: a workspace-wide walk returns the same 71 with a symmetric difference of ZERO against the per-package union. Build-only packages named rather than counted: showreel adds autocfg; prez adds entities, fastrand, phf_codegen, phf_generator. Overlap between prez and showreel remains ZERO, so the union equals the arithmetic sum here and the row's original "overstates by 10 through shared transitive deps" stays refuted. AND THE ROW'S OWN LESSON LANDED ON IT TWICE: it demanded that populations be named, was refuted for stating a union that was not one, and then the named edge set STILL under-determined the answer by two.
